scope.title: AoA replatform testing and remaining acceptance
scope.conclusion: Both installations and substantial distributed engineering behavior are validated. The branch is not ready for release acceptance. Development gaps, reproducible failures, and operational campaigns remain.
scope.authority: This is an engineering evidence report. No repository ticket, epic, rollout flag or release gate was formally promoted by this testing session. Passed checks below may be checked off at their stated scope; existing milestone completion is governed by the repository ledgers.
sources: Current M4 implementation and later performance observations

E2B graceful cancellation and exit codes
Decide whether workload contracts require unsupported graceful process cancellation/exit-code inspection, negotiate honest capabilities and verify fallback behavior. Forced kill is tested.

Use the suite result and file manifest to identify skips and opt-in fixtures outside the executed lane. Linux kernel/socket browser checks, other operating systems and signed desktop install/update cannot be inferred from Windows normal tests.
Full suite and Windows opt-in manifests
Real coding provider through distributed app

Use a supported company-key credential cohort and pinned coding template; execute actual Commander, crew, extraction and task sources with cancellation, outputs, cost/audit and retention. Local personal subscription proof cannot substitute. Anthropic live verification remains explicitly deferred by repository direction.

Run 20 seeds × 10,000 operations across ≥10 organizations; ≥1,000 concurrent lease/ACK/renew/replacement races; ≥100,000 events with ≥10,000 in each of six fault classes; ≥100 sandbox lifecycle faults. Cancellation must reach worker-visible terminal/force-kill within 30s and cleanup within 5min, with exact artifact integrity and zero final resource/event/authority leaks. Current bounded fixtures are a subset.

Resolve the documented M3-versus-M4 gate-owner decision first; this report does not assign it. Then at least 120 jobs across six 20-job outcome cohorts, three consecutive clean candidate campaigns, cancel/cleanup percentile limits, workspace integrity and provider outage/rotation/limit matrix. Keep spend bounded by a separately prepared campaign.
After P04/P05, ≥100 journeys, three runs, approvals/denials/reconnect, uploads/downloads, credential rotation, private/metadata denial, artifact digest/order and bounded cancel/cleanup.
72 consecutive hours, required replica/worker restarts, 15-minute partition, drain/generation/checkpoint/budget-stop and pause or provider outage route; prove fenced effects and cleanup.

Provision ≥2 control planes behind production load balancing, ≥4 workers across ≥2 failure domains, external PostgreSQL/object storage, shared broker/admission, managed secrets/TLS/telemetry/backup/signing. Single Helsinki VPS is one failure domain.

On that topology: zero lost accepted writes/double execution, failover≤60s/RPO0, rolling deploy/drain/migration-first compatibility and timed socket catch-up≤5min. Nonidentical N/N-1 is required when protocol changes.

Measure API submission/poll/event ACK, throughput and queue delays under the complete D5 workload, noisy org≥10×, quiet throughput≥90% and delay≤2× baseline; 5xx≤0.1%, p95≤750/1000/500ms and no double quota release.

External DB and versioned object restore on the candidate; exact recoverable commit/object age, RPO≤15min and full-service RTO≤4h, corrupt/missing quarantine, old-fence denial, signed URL isolation, reenrollment/revoke and compatible rollout.

Satisfy same-candidate upstream gates and freeze the support matrix. Run 14 days with ≥3 external organizations, each advertising and exercising coding, browser and service. Campaign floors are ≥100 completed coding jobs, ≥50 browser journeys, ≥72 accumulated healthy service-hours and ≥1,000 completed attempts. Each advertised row needs ≥200 normal probes, availability ≥99.5% and ≥3 separately counted fail-closed denials. Meet incident/security, on-call/support/kill/cutover/rollback/legal/data requirements. Formal owner decisions remain separate from this report.

If disabled, prove routes/enrollment/leasing/update/handoff are off with no fallback. If enabled, test each advertised OS installer/signature/update/rollback/keychain/device broker, folder confinement, offline buffer, revocation and quarantine. Advertised mobility needs ≥10 successful handoffs and ≥3 fault cases per directed pair.
Conditional DSK and D6 support matrix

findings.title: Playwright parity test cannot resolve a transitive dependency

findings.action: Review dependency declaration/module resolution without masking the image/version parity assertion.

findings.evidence: App recognized auth.json, verify returned 200/verified, and user_message run completed with model gpt-5.6-luna. AOA_SUBSCRIPTION_OK persisted after reload.
findings.action: Retain this test company model override until TST-008 is resolved. No OpenAI API key was needed.

findings.title: Public cloud personal-subscription/device execution is not implemented or accepted
findings.evidence: Cloud onboarding explicitly defers local CLI Commander; source documents company-key distributed paths separately from the unfinished full device credential broker.

findings.action: Record an explicit capability disposition for workloads that require graceful cancellation/exit codes; forced kill was tested successfully.

findings.title: Release operational acceptance is incomplete
findings.action: Complete the prescribed sustained capacity/churn campaign, failure-domain and recovery timing checks, upgrade/rollback on deployment topology, real provider fault/rotation rehearsals, and release acceptance owner sign-off. A single VPS with local_disk storage is not that topology.

findings.title: Hardcoded gpt-5.5 default breaks Codex subscription onboarding
findings.evidence: After successful login the hello probe returned HTTP 400: gpt-5.5 is not supported with ChatGPT authentication. Official retirement took effect 15 October 2026 at 00:30 IST. Setting test company model to gpt-5.6-luna from the pinned CLI model catalog made the identical probe pass.
findings.action: Update default/model-availability handling and review CLI compatibility pins. Validate onboarding, Commander, crew and saved managed configurations against models actually available to that account/client. Product code was not changed.

findings.title: Native background crew path still needs validation
findings.evidence: A sweep.steward background run failed after the successful Commander turn. Local setup logs also warn that the agent JWT signing secret is absent; this warning alone does not prove the failure cause.
findings.action: Provision persistent local agent JWT signing configuration and validate crew authentication, available model resolution and actual tool calls before accepting the background crew path.

findings.title: Opt-in startup and serving-role validation has failures
findings.evidence: Broad lane reported five startup-file failures. Focused unchanged repeat: native exit1, five failed and72 filtered skips,346.78s. ACL sweep again exceeded300s. Operator-schema case expected operator_authority but received app_authority; all three child tests exited at app-authority before their sentinel/port/metrics assertions. The shared ACL mutation loop does not observe test abort and may continue after Vitest times out the outer promise; fixture cascade is strongly supported structurally, but an independent isolation experiment was not run.
findings.action: Reproduce the expensive ACL case and verify teardown/state restoration before classifying later failures. Then isolate the operator and native child-server assertions on supported Windows and authoritative Linux CI. Preserve this lane and its skips; no baseline waiver is established.

sections.title: How local and VPS delegation was tested
paragraphs: A shared environment has one logical control-plane authority, which may have multiple replicas. Workers enroll into that authority. Two complete AoA installations with independent databases do not delegate to each other as peer applications.

Both cross-host directions were tested as separate fixture environments. A private SSH tunnel carried control traffic; a test-only ingress bridge/host allowlist allowed the Docker Desktop path. This differs from the original hermetic network topology.

The later successful VPS-to-PC job used the VPS test authority and a separate local Docker worker/reference provider. It did not use the public Google-authenticated app, the native port-3210 app, or the user’s personal Codex login. A real local Node environment probe and unique result marker establish where that bounded fixture executed; ordinary reference-provider output is scripted.

The native local application independently completed a real Codex subscription Commander turn. Combining that personal subscription with a VPS-issued task needs the unimplemented device-local credential/execution path. Copying auth files to the VPS was not used.

paragraphs: The lanes overlap; their test counts must not be added into a unique-test total. A composite node:test recovery test contains multiple checks but is still one test. Counts labeled per host are independent executions of the same assertions.

The initial Node 26 run is preserved as failed evidence. The supported Node 24 result supersedes it for the current normal-lane verdict; isolated repeats do not erase failures or establish the three-run stability requirement.

The explicit Windows manifest selects the 123 test files that mention AOA_RUN_WIN_INTEGRATION, enables that flag, and executes serially with the real embedded PostgreSQL prerequisites. Its JSON manifest is retained. Any remaining skips are still excluded from the passing count.

All123 Windows file reports completed, but the PowerShell5 wrapper raised NativeCommandError while Vitest wrote its final stderr report. Windows counts are therefore summed from those complete per-file reports; the final native exit, global uncaught-error count and final duration were not captured. Unknown is not zero. The original UTF16LE log and a decoded UTF8 copy are retained. Focused direct-Node runs capture final reports separately; they do not replace the whole-lane failure.

The normal Windows suite leaves platform/live/integration opt-ins skipped. Full browser-provider acceptance, Linux kernel/socket assertions and other operating systems require their own lanes. rows: 30 required cases observed; 26 test callbacks passed. Independent checker exit 0.

d1.credential.production_reader_company_predicate: structural; owner M1a-D2-MECHANISM, case d2m.credential.production_reader_company_predicate, per E6-D003; STRUCTURALLY UNAVAILABLE ON THIS LANE, and ROUTED by E6-D003 (planning session, F2) to the M1a-D2-MECHANISM profile -- it is NOT an oversight and NOT unowned. Measured at source: reaching this reader's decision needs authorizeSecretResolve to ADMIT, which needs a resolvable device_local credential; server/src/services/device-local-broker.ts holds failClosedDeviceLocalBroker and no other implementation in the tree, and the fenced route collapses every outcome to denied/malformed by design (it must not be an oracle). So on D1 an admitted read and a denied one are indistinguishable at every observable surface, and a case built here could not tell its two arms apart. Its sibling d1.tenant.legacy.provider_credentials proves the PREDICATE and the grant on the same non-owner pool, with both controls; this case is the reader's own invocation of it and is never a pass here.

Node test exit 1 is expected to be nonzero. Control verdict: PASS: suppressed injections make the evidence verdict fail as required. The retained log must contain the evidence verdict and injection_did_not_fire.

paragraphs: The current M4 ledger retains a ten-loop synthetic queue-delay failure after the readiness optimization. It later adds real-daemon measurements with larger validated provider profiles: quiet throughput and delay ratios improved, while noisy work still missed the fixed drain deadline.

Those are earlier developer runs preserved in the branch, not measurements newly reproduced by this test session. The latest quiet ratios cannot replace the unresolved noisy-work deadline or full-scale acceptance. The ledger also contains 112 baseline and 290 loaded completed-request HTTP samples; submit latency and a complete error-rate denominator remain unmeasured. Our zero-error health probes measure endpoint reachability/latency only.

Helsinki round-trip delay is expected for the Windows client. Host-local and client-to-VPS percentiles are reported separately; neither is a substitute for submit/poll/event-ACK percentiles under the required job load.

sections.title: How to read the remaining work
paragraphs: Remaining rows have different prerequisites. Device execution and browser enforcement need development; provider capability rows need an honest disposition; operational campaigns need their declared infrastructure, credentials or calendar window. A failing test may need a fixture correction rather than a product fix. These are not sixteen demonstrated production defects.

The targeted startup repeat reproduced all five selected failures together: an exhaustive ACL timeout followed by app-authority rejections on the shared fixture. This does not demonstrate four independent security failures. The submission logging repeat passed42/42; its original empty capture and the broad-lane failure remain retained.

sections.title: Remaining testing and why it remains
rows: Implement the device-local credential broker and supported desktop execution backend, preserving owner/org/target/fence binding. Then submit from the actual public VPS app, execute with the PC subscription, test cancel/revoke/partition and return governed outputs. DSK-04 here is a gate clause; the separate DSK-004 ticket concerns updates/drain/rollback.
TST-005; MIG-001; gate DSK-04; M1/M2 ledger

Replace hardcoded gpt-5.5 selection with supported model/default handling and validate stored configurations. Retest fresh login, verify, Commander, crew and extraction without a manual test-company workaround.

Resolve direct playwright-core parity-test resolution; investigate sink/flush capture, stale-heartbeat, import/AST timeout, UI-state, exhaustive ACL/startup and artifact-export assertions. Preserve the original broad-lane failures despite focused passes. Repeat required acceptance lanes with the corrected output capture after fixes.

Provide and verify actual default-deny enforcement covering all escape classes and immutable attestation. Then enable the governed browser cohort and execute D3. Host SOCKS proxy alone does not satisfy the documented boundary.

Prove production application cookie/session issuer compatibility with the encrypted broker/isolated guest lifecycle, including denial, expiry, withdrawal and revoke. Existing staged HTTPS fixtures do not settle this.

Retain the branch ten-loop queue-delay failure and real-daemon noisy backlog deadline failures. Isolate remaining causes and retest fixed arrivals/profiles/thresholds; include complete denominator and real worker/provider fleet. Later bounded quiet ratios improving does not erase missed noisy work.

Current receipt/ticket metadata does not support validated legacy adoption. Implement the required authenticated binding if adoption is a supported feature; otherwise test/document revoke-retire-new-target migration.

Provision persistent signing configuration, identify the observed sweep.steward failure, validate account-available crew models and run an actual tool/task path. Missing JWT warning is a clue, not a proven cause.
E2B graceful cancellation and exit codes
Decide whether workload contracts require unsupported graceful process cancellation/exit-code inspection, negotiate honest capabilities and verify fallback behavior. Forced kill is tested.

Use the suite result and file manifest to identify skips and opt-in fixtures outside the executed lane. Linux kernel/socket browser checks, other operating systems and signed desktop install/update cannot be inferred from Windows normal tests.
Full suite and Windows opt-in manifests
Real coding provider through distributed app

Use a supported company-key credential cohort and pinned coding template; execute actual Commander, crew, extraction and task sources with cancellation, outputs, cost/audit and retention. Local personal subscription proof cannot substitute. Anthropic live verification remains explicitly deferred by repository direction.

Run 20 seeds × 10,000 operations across ≥10 organizations; ≥1,000 concurrent lease/ACK/renew/replacement races; ≥100,000 events with ≥10,000 in each of six fault classes; ≥100 sandbox lifecycle faults. Cancellation must reach worker-visible terminal/force-kill within 30s and cleanup within 5min, with exact artifact integrity and zero final resource/event/authority leaks. Current bounded fixtures are a subset.

Resolve the documented M3-versus-M4 gate-owner decision first; this report does not assign it. Then at least 120 jobs across six 20-job outcome cohorts, three consecutive clean candidate campaigns, cancel/cleanup percentile limits, workspace integrity and provider outage/rotation/limit matrix. Keep spend bounded by a separately prepared campaign.
After P04/P05, ≥100 journeys, three runs, approvals/denials/reconnect, uploads/downloads, credential rotation, private/metadata denial, artifact digest/order and bounded cancel/cleanup.
72 consecutive hours, required replica/worker restarts, 15-minute partition, drain/generation/checkpoint/budget-stop and pause or provider outage route; prove fenced effects and cleanup.

Provision ≥2 control planes behind production load balancing, ≥4 workers across ≥2 failure domains, external PostgreSQL/object storage, shared broker/admission, managed secrets/TLS/telemetry/backup/signing. Single Helsinki VPS is one failure domain.

On that topology: zero lost accepted writes/double execution, failover≤60s/RPO0, rolling deploy/drain/migration-first compatibility and timed socket catch-up≤5min. Nonidentical N/N-1 is required when protocol changes.

Measure API submission/poll/event ACK, throughput and queue delays under the complete D5 workload, noisy org≥10×, quiet throughput≥90% and delay≤2× baseline; 5xx≤0.1%, p95≤750/1000/500ms and no double quota release.

External DB and versioned object restore on the candidate; exact recoverable commit/object age, RPO≤15min and full-service RTO≤4h, corrupt/missing quarantine, old-fence denial, signed URL isolation, reenrollment/revoke and compatible rollout.

Satisfy same-candidate upstream gates and freeze the support matrix. Run 14 days with ≥3 external organizations, each advertising and exercising coding, browser and service. Campaign floors are ≥100 completed coding jobs, ≥50 browser journeys, ≥72 accumulated healthy service-hours and ≥1,000 completed attempts. Each advertised row needs ≥200 normal probes, availability ≥99.5% and ≥3 separately counted fail-closed denials. Meet incident/security, on-call/support/kill/cutover/rollback/legal/data requirements. Formal owner decisions remain separate from this report.

If disabled, prove routes/enrollment/leasing/update/handoff are off with no fallback. If enabled, test each advertised OS installer/signature/update/rollback/keychain/device broker, folder confinement, offline buffer, revocation and quarantine. Advertised mobility needs ≥10 successful handoffs and ≥3 fault cases per directed pair.
Conditional DSK and D6 support matrix

REL-001, REL-002 and REL-005 still lack their own ticket files at this candidate. Write their Step-0 plans and acceptance mappings; REL-002 remainder is unspecified. Resolve the kill-switch UI/drain-integration decision and operator surface. The authorized kill-switch API write path already exists and must not be duplicated.

At the governed M5 main-integration checkpoint, remove the owned cross-platform-weekly.yml@main block and obtain a successful scheduled verdict-bearing main run. DEP-013 consumer must read it and report zero findings. A canceled/failed/manual substitute does not satisfy this exit. No merge or publication was performed here.

sections.title: Suggested execution order
paragraphs: 1. Resolve supported-runtime failures and the default-model issue; diagnose native crew setup. Repeat the normal and affected integration lanes, retaining old attempts.

2. Choose the supported credential/execution cohort. For the requested public VPS-to-personal-PC workflow, implement and test the device-local broker/backend. Independently prove the company-key distributed task/Commander/crew/extraction journey with a pinned agent template.

3. Resolve browser-provider enforcement and application-session compatibility; run governed browser journeys. Investigate outstanding real-daemon capacity/fairness behavior without weakening workload/deadline thresholds.
4. Prepare the required external-store, multi-worker, two-failure-domain staging topology. Run exact D1/D2/D3 cohorts, 72-hour D4, then full load/HA/recovery/upgrade acceptance.

5. Freeze the advertised support matrix and run D6 with external organizations and the required calendar window. Record formal owner acceptance on the exact candidate. A single-host engineering test cannot supply that acceptance.

sections.title: Final installation state and cost scope
paragraphs: The native Windows app and public HTTPS VPS app remain available. Standard private D1 fixture stacks remain. Temporary cross-host job/heartbeat probes and SSH tunnels, extra replica, and separate foundation/fault-campaign stacks are stopped; durable fixture data/identities retained.

All E2B resources tagged by these tests were reclaimed. Three short-lived sandboxes were used, with no model API calls; local Commander used the signed-in subscription. No final dollar charge was retrieved.

Google and E2B credentials remain in protected VPS configuration; no credential values are included here. Database/provider-management boundaries and separate fixture data remain important when extending these tests.

The epic index and some early milestone checkpoints contain stale status prose. Use the current M1/M2, M3 and complete M4 execution ledgers alongside normative gates. In particular, an old E7 backlog label or a pre-sprint “no distributed job” paragraph is not the current execution status.
